indexArchive.note: NRLMSIS expects an 81-day average CENTRED on the day; a centred average is half future and is not knowable at the origin, so the TRAILING 81-day mean is supplied instead. That biases the absolute density the model returns and does not bias the covariate's causality.

A_interceptOnly.note: POST-REGISTRATION control, labelled as such. The model may learn only the training median offset at each horizon and no covariate at all. Whatever gain appears here is the removal of a BIAS and is not evidence of any structure; only the increment of arm A over this arm is attributable to the covariates.

C.note: catalogue self-consistency, NOT truth: the later element set is the archive's own estimate and this arm cannot say which side is closer to reality
